verdict.rationale: Mercury's official mercury-skills repo ships a first-party `mercury-detect-anomaly` agent skill that drives the Mercury CLI. That is a product-owned AI capability for spotting anomalous transactions, but it is only named, not documented in depth. It also runs inside the user's own agent rather than as automatic, always-on flagging within Mercury. Spend controls, approval policies and gated disbursements are policy and manual-review features, not AI flagging, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: automatic or continuous in-product anomaly detection, AI flagging of out-of-policy transactions against spend policies, routing of flagged items into a review queue, detailed documentation of the anomaly skill's behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
